description: The Sudus status line and pane: session.start binds the refresh and runs wake, turn.start and turn.complete refresh the face and the verdict, tool.call on Bash refreshes after a sudus, cairn or git command, ui.render draws the pane, ui.close remembers a pane the person closed. Claude Code reads this file through plugin.json; hooks/hooks.json keeps the shell hooks every harness reads
